Xech Clearpods Earbuds With Power Bank – Transparent TWS with 120+ Hours Playtime

Meet the Xech Clearpods Earbuds With Power bank-2000mah, a powerful blend of futuristic design, premium audio, and everyday utility. Built for users who want style with performance, these true wireless feature a see-through transparent body, long battery life, and an integrated power bank that keeps your essential devices alive wherever you go. Whether you’re commuting, traveling, working, or gaming, Clearpods are designed to deliver uninterrupted sound and dependable backup power.

With advanced TWS function and super-fast charging support, the pair instantly with your smartphone, tablet, or laptop to offer seamless connectivity and rich stereo sound. The smart battery status display helps you track power levels in real time, while the dual in-built charging cables allow you to charge multiple gadgets without carrying extra wires.

Enjoy massive 120+ hours of play time combined with up to 240 hours standby time, making them ideal for long trips and heavy daily usage. The ergonomic fit ensures comfort for extended listening, while the crystal-clear audio and deep bass elevate music, movies, and calls.

  • Stylish see-through transparent body with premium futuristic design
  • True wireless earbuds with stable and fast auto pairing
  • Integrated 2000mAh power bank for emergency charging
  • Charge 3 devices simultaneously with 2 in-built cables + wireless earbuds
  • Smart battery status display for accurate power monitoring
  • Super-fast charging for both earbuds and connected devices
  • Massive 120+ hours play time for music and calls
  • Up to 240 hours standby time for long-lasting readiness
  • Comfortable in-ear fit for workouts, travel, and office use
  • Perfect for Android and iOS smartphones

Designed for Modern Lifestyles

The Clearpods are more than just Bluetooth. They function as your compact power solution, ensuring you never run out of battery during crucial moments. From business meetings to gaming sessions, these earbuds maintain strong connectivity, low latency, and immersive audio output.

Thanks to the powerful 2000mAh battery inside the case, you can recharge your multiple times while also powering additional devices. The transparent finish gives them a bold, high-tech look that stands out from ordinary wireless earphones.

Unmatched Battery Performance

Battery anxiety becomes a thing of the past. With over 120 hours of playtime and an incredible 240 hours standby, you can listen longer, talk longer, and travel farther without searching for a charger. The LED battery indicator keeps you informed, making power management simple and stress-free.

Why Choose?

If you want with capability, fast charging, long battery life, and premium transparent design, Clearpods deliver exceptional value. They combine practicality with cutting-edge aesthetics, making them a perfect gift and an everyday essential for students, professionals, and travelers. Upgrade to smarter audio and smarter charging with the Clearpods – where innovation meets convenience.
